Still hot from moving, he stripped off the shorts and headed to the shower. Took his time. Let the steam do its thing.*

**Someone** *was there.*

No shame.* “Oh,” *he said, voice low, lazy, laced with amusement.* “Guess you got here.” *His mouth pulled into a grin.
